scraped_content.meta_description: All the latest news from Black's Creek Public Shooting Range (BCR)
scraped_content.main_text: Black's Creek Public Shooting Range | Idaho Fish and Game Skip to main content Search Idaho Fish and Game Black's Creek Public Shooting Range Black's Creek Public Shooting Range (BCR), located just southeast of Boise, is the largest and most visited shooting range in Idaho, providing a safe place to shoot for more than 14,000 hunters and sport shooters each year. BCR is one of four Idaho shooting ranges owned by the Idaho Department of Fish and Game. scraped_content.main_text: Double Tapp | Boise Shooting Range Scroll Double Tapp Range is a PRIVATE range and not open to the general public. We are members only. Guests may be brought out by active range members at a cost of $10 per guest, per day. Guest fees will be going up to $15 per guest per day beginning January 1st 2025. Our memberships are currently capped, and we have over 100 people on our membership waitlist. We are not taking any additions to our waitlist until we have new ranges done and space available. Overbooking the range would be detrimental to the experience enjoyed by our members. Please check back during the Spring of 2025.UPCOMING TRAINING: Our next Pistol & Personal Safety Classroom session will be as follows:Date: Pending Time: PendingLocation: Pending You can always schedule a private range session anytime! Our range sessions are all PRIVATE with just you and your family/friends. We are currently signing up people for the PRIVATE half day range training sessions. We have dates available now. Please click here for more information or email mark@doubletappboise.com to schedule a private range training session. Welcome to Double Tapp Range (DTR). DTR is one of the finest private firearm ranges in Idaho. This is a 160 acre MEMBERS ONLY facility, located just 16 miles east of Boise, just off of I-84 at exit 71. Click the link at the bottom of the page to bring up a map of our location. DTR is in a constant state of growth and refinement. Tremendous growth has been taking place at DTR every year and we are on track to be the best private range in the Pacific Northwest within a few years. We offer range membership, a multitude of training opportunities, FFL transfers, and more. Click on any of the menu selections above for additional information. Mark has spent a lifetime working for law enforcement agencies and has amassed a significant level in experience that he looks forward to sharing with you. DTR has a presence on social media. Icons at the top left of any page are directed to our accounts. If you have any questions, the bottom of any page, click on “Email Mark” to send a message and we will do our best to get back to you promptly!We currently have 6 ranges available for member use, and 7 more under construction. Many of our ranges have cement pads and shade covers overhead for protection from the elements. Range #1 is a 50 yards deep by 50 yards wide. It is primarily a pistol range. Range #1 is equipped with a very nice enclosed building right behind the firing line. This provides the shooter with protection from the elements, and makes for a more comfortable shooting experience regardless of the time of year. This range has 24 lanes and a very nice sand covered range surface. This range is the primary range for member use, though members can use any of the other ranges as well, as they are available. The 100 yard range is equipped with very nice, custom built, steel shooting tables that are very heavy and bolted to the ground. We have two modern vault toilet systems, which are odorless and very nice. We work hard to keep these restrooms clean and well maintained. We get more compliments on our restrooms than anything else! The range is always open during daylight hours, 365 days a year, with rare exceptions for range maintenance or safety considerations. The gate will either be standing open, or closed but unlocked. The gate on the west side of our property leads out onto thousands of acres of BLM property. It is locked at all times, but members can utilize that gate, for easy access to the BLM ground out in that direction. There are many target stands and sticks on all ranges. We have a large number of cardboard backers located in the buildings on range. Just bring your paper targets and a stapler! We just ask that members bring cardboard backers back into the building when not in use, as the wind and moisture can completely destroys them over night. Members are free to use any of the ranges on site, with the exception of the Law Enforcement ranges which are signed and gated. Members always have access to Range 1 (enclosed building with roll-up doors). On the weekends, instructors can book the other ranges, but we've never seen all ranges being used at the same time. During the week its generally very light usage, making it perfect for retired people, shift workers, or others with free time mid-week.

SCHEDULE HERE UPCOMING COURSES AND EVENTS FUNDAMENTALS MASTERY COURSE SEPT 20TH @ DOUBLE TAPP 9AM8 HOURS - 500 ROUNDS - PISTOL SIGN UP PISTOL 2 INTRO TO MOVEMENT JUNE 21ST @ DOUBLE TAPP 9AM8 HOURS - 500 ROUNDS Click Here DYNAMIC PISTOL APPLICATIONS AUG 16TH @ DOUBLE TAPP 9AM8 HOURS - 700 ROUNDS Click Here ENHANCED CONCEALED CARRY MONTHLY @ SIMSHOT2 DAY - 8 HOURS - 100 ROUNDS reserve here INTRO TO AR-15 / CARBINE JULY 12TH @ DOUBLE TAPP8 HOURS - 500 ROUNDS Click Here USCCA DEFENSIVE PISTOL (5 DAY) 5 DAYS - 1000 ROUNDSCALL TO BOOK reserve here FAQs What is a Firearm Simulator? A firearm simulator is a training system that replicates real-world shooting scenarios using virtual or augmented reality, laser-based firearms, or computerized environments. These simulators provide a safe and controlled setting for users to practice marksmanship, decision-making, and tactical responses without the risks or costs associated with live ammunition. They are commonly used by military, law enforcement, and civilian firearm trainers to enhance shooting skills, improve reaction times, and refine judgment under pressure. Are simulator appointments private? Yes! Every session on our simulator is completely private. However, we also offer two, three, and four-shooter sessions, allowing you to bring friends, family, or anyone you'd like to join in the experience. What do I need to bring? Absolutely nothing! We provide everything you need, including replica firearms, holsters, belts, and more. However, if you prefer to use your own holster or battle belt, you're more than welcome to bring it. What is Judgement Training? judgment training scenarios are interactive simulations designed to improve decision-making skills related to firearm use in real-world situations. These scenarios immerse participants in realistic, controlled environments where they must rapidly assess threats, determine appropriate responses, and decide whether or not to use force. The goal is to enhance judgment, situational awareness, and responsible firearm handling under stress, reinforcing safe and lawful outcomes. Does Simshot offer Live Fire classes? YES! We offer live-fire training classes all year long! Visit our Courses page to explore our current schedule and find the perfect class for you.

scraped_content.main_text: Combat Absolute LLC-Firearm Training Courses-Boise, Idaho top of pageCOMBAT ABSOLUTEFIREARM TRAINING IN BOISE, IDABOUT Kyle Gentry is the owner and lead instructor for Combat Absolute. Kyle served as a Law Enforcement Officer for 17 years, where he was collaterally assigned as the lead firearm instructor for his police department. In addition, Kyle was a SWAT operator and SWAT sniper. He was assigned as the SWAT Rangemaster/lead firearm instructor for SWAT and lead instructor for the sniper team. He is a certified Simunition instructor and less lethal device instructor. Kyle is a certified Glock, Colt and Sig Sauer armorer. He was responsible for creating and implementing a red dot sight (RDS) pistol training program for his agency, which allowed officers to utilize a pistol mounted RDS on patrol. As a forever student, Kyle has trained (and still trains) with many of the country's top tier trainers and organizations.
